name: crew-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live panel of subagents (/crew). Works in any session: no companion skill, no setup.

autoOpen.title: Open the crew panel
autoOpen.description: first-agent: once per session, when the first subagent starts. never: only with /crew or the button on the bar.

glyphs.title: Terminal icons
glyphs.description: nerd: rounded progress bar and icons, needs a Nerd Font in your terminal. plain: standard Unicode only.
